high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Deccan Chronicle website, dated 12:52 PM. The article is titled "GHMC Seals 150+ Properties..." and discusses a crackdown by officials of the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC) against property tax defaulters in the Kukatpally zone of Hyderabad. The main headline states that over 150 properties have been sealed within 30 days. It mentions that most of these properties are commercial establishments with significant arrears in property tax.
